usage.settings.label: Usage statistics
usage.settings.toggle: Keep local usage statistics to improve your layout
usage.title: Usage statistics
usage.about: Kept on this computer only and never sent anywhere. They record which features you use, how you reach them and where you get stuck: not what you look at. No file names, paths, level names, player names or data values are recorded.
usage.aboutWords: Two things keep your own words: a command-palette search that finds nothing (so a missing command can be added where you looked for it), and feedback you write on a control.
usage.state.local: On: kept in this browser and in this install's local usage folder.
usage.state.localKey: Switched on for this install by its local settings file.
usage.state.counts: {kept, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} kept since this page opened
usage.delete.confirm: Delete every usage statistic kept in this browser, and the local usage files this install's server wrote?
usage.page.title: Your usage
usage.page.summary: {events, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} from {sessions, plural, one {# visit} other {# visits}}, {active} active
usage.page.hard: Hard to reach for how often you use it
usage.page.classes: Features you have not used, by likely reason
usage.page.report: The full report, with every feature: node tools/usage-report.mjs
usage.feedback.title: Feedback
usage.feedback.about: Kept with your usage statistics on this computer, never sent anywhere.
